page_title: PSG 4-0 MAR | PSG v Marseille 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' 4 - 0 Goal! Randal Kolo Muani produces a great pass that finds Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 4:0.
86' Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper rises and gathers the ball.
85' Renan Lodi (Marseille) receives a yellow card.
83' Substitution. Leonardo Balerdi will be replaced by Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille).
83' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Carlos Soler (Paris SG) replaces Bradley Barcola.
83' Jacques Abardonado decides to make a substitution. Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) will be replaced by Bilal Nadir.
83' Substitution. Achraf Hakimi walks off the pitch and Nordi Mukiele (Paris SG) comes on as a substitute.
82' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) picked up a yellow card from referee.
80' Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
80' The resulting corner from Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. Now Paris SG have a corner.
79' Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Paris SG will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
78' That's unlucky! Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang departs the field of play to be replaced by Joaquin Correa (Marseille).
73' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Samuel Gigot (Marseille) was quite harsh and Willy Delajod didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
72' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) is furious with himself for wasting a glorious chance. He pounces on the rebound around the penalty spot and drags a shot well wide of the left post.
71' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
70' The resulting set piece from Marseille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
69' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ousmane Dembele will be replaced by Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG).
69' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Lucas Hernandez is replaced by Danilo Pereira (Paris SG).
67' A quickly taken corner by Paris SG.
65' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
63' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing. The ball goes out of play and Paris SG will have a goal kick.
61' Amine Harit (Marseille) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee signals a corner kick to Marseille.
61' Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) makes a strong challenge and Willy Delajod blows for a foul.
59' A pass lands at the feet of Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
56' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
55' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
54' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) unleashes a powerful shot from the free kick but it only hits the defensive wall. The ball is out of play. Paris SG win a corner kick.
53' Willy Delajod blows his whistle. Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) commits a foul after dangerous play. Paris SG win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
52' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
51' Ousmane Dembele picks out Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG), who makes a total mess of his shot from mid-range and sends the ball high over the bar.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
47' 3 - 0 Goal! Ousmane Dembele gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) climbs highest and powers a close-range header into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Vitinha is replaced by Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille).
46' Jacques Abardonado has made a change at the break. Amine Harit has come on in place of Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Some great play by Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Pau Lopez sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
44' Ousmane Dembele pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Milan Skriniar (Paris SG) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
44' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
44' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG), but one of the defenders gets it clear. Paris SG have been awarded a corner kick.
43' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Paris SG have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Vitinha (Marseille) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
41' The linesman signals that Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
39' Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) commits a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
37' 2 - 0 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 2:0.

37' Good touch by Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) as he latched on to an accurate pass before attempting to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range shot. Unluckily for him, his attempt only rattles the left post.
36' Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
32' Luis Enrique is forced to make a change. Kylian Mbappe is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG).
32' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
30' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

29' Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Corner kick. Paris SG will have an opportunity.
28' Paris SG keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
24' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. It's a throw-in for Marseille.
22' What a chance that is! Vitinha (Marseille) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
21' Willy Delajod blows for a foul after Vitinha (Marseille) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
19' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
17' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) takes the corner with a short pass.
17' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The linesman makes the right call and Paris SG will have a corner.
15' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Willy Delajod blows for a foul.
12' Vitinha (Marseille) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
11' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) plays a lovely through ball to Kylian Mbappe, but he can't beat Pau Lopez and loses the ball.
9' Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
8' 1 - 0 Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) sets the ball for the free kick and fires in a beautiful strike, which nestles exactly in the top right corner.
7' Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul after Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) hacks down one of his opponents. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Paris SG.
4' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
3' Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) sends a long ball forward to Ousmane Dembele, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is behind the touchline and Marseille will take a throw-in.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Paris SG will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Willy Delajod.
